items.description: The Essex coast from Clacton to and including, St Peters Flat and the Colne and Blackwater estuaries
items.message:
High tides over the next two days may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 11:45pm Tuesday 27th October to 1:45am Wednesday 28th October 
Clacton Promenade, Lee-over-Sands and Brightlingsea sea front may see some wave overtopping spray. The Strood at Mersea Island, Coast Road and car parks on the front at West Mersea, and the Hythe and Promenade at Maldon may flood. The detailed forecast is for a peak level at Clacton of 2.96mAODN at 00:45am, on Wednesday 28th October, which is 0.38m above tide tables, Wind Force 5, Westerly. The high tide tomorrow afternoon is expected to be as high, with a peak level at Clacton of 2.94mAODN at 12:30pm, on Wednesday 28th October, which is 0.35m above tide tables, Wind Force 5, South Westerly. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded.   
This message will be updated by 11:00AM on Wednesday 28 October or as the situation changes.
